description: Full record for one property: beds by room, amenities with details, access and stairs, rules, host FAQ, policies, and verification status. The location is approximate on purpose: the exact address and the host's direct contact details are not in the record and are sent to the guest after a confirmed booking, so if asked, say that rather than that they are missing. Maps to GET /v1/properties/{id}.

property_id.description: The property's id, from search_stays (starts with prop_).

name: get_property

outputSchema.description: Everything public about one place: description, rooms and beds, amenities, access, rules, policies, photos and the host's answers to common questions.

title: Get property details
